notes: v1.1.105: No more 'Not Responding' - Account Info tables that are not on screen are no longer redrawn/rebuilt (they update the moment their tab is opened), the face-photo column no longer checks files on the UI thread, and the window gets its turn first on a busy PC. Hotmail/Outlook codes: Junk folder is read too (Facebook mail often lands there), a code that arrived before the first inbox look is used, mail times compared in true time, no 3x3-minute wait when the mailbox can't be opened (the reason is shown), faster reads (token kept), no more password-IMAP to Outlook (Microsoft turned it off). Fixed: a login-alert mail's colour number (#141823) was taken as the Facebook code.
